verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a sandbox test environment where you can connect your application to a bank and access test accounts to simulate the real Open Banking experience. That covers the core idea of testing linking and data access before using a real account. Missing for 10: named test institutions, documented test credentials, any way to simulate error states (e.g. failed consent or SCA rejection), detail on the end-to-end sandbox flow for data retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
